import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE;

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap, cost;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        static final int MAXN = 10001;
        List<Edge>[] adj;
        int nodes;
        int[] dist, potential, levelArr, iterArr;
        boolean[] done;

        MinCostFlow() {
            nodes = 0;
            adj = new ArrayList[MAXN];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            dist = new int[MAXN];
            potential = new int[MAXN];
            levelArr = new int[MAXN];
            iterArr = new int[MAXN];
            done = new boolean[MAXN];
        }

        int addNodes(int cnt) {
            nodes += cnt;
            return nodes - 1;
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
            adj[u].add(new Edge(v, adj[v].size(), cap, cost));
            adj[v].add(new Edge(u, adj[u].size() - 1, 0, -cost));
        }

        boolean dijkstra(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            Arrays.fill(done, false);
            PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
            dist[s] = 0;
            pq.offer(new int[]{0, s});

            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                int[] cur = pq.poll();
                int du = cur[0], u = cur[1];
                if (done[u]) continue;
                done[u] = true;

                for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                    int v = e.to;
                    if (e.cap == 0 || done[v]) continue;
                    int nd = du + potential[u] + e.cost - potential[v];
                    if (dist[v] > nd) {
                        dist[v] = nd;
                        pq.offer(new int[]{nd, v});
                    }
                }
            }
            return done[t];
        }

        boolean buildLevelGraph(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(levelArr, 0);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            levelArr[s] = 1;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                    int v = e.to;
                    if (e.cap == 0 || levelArr[v] != 0) continue;
                    if (dist[v] == dist[u] + e.cost - potential[v] + potential[u]) {
                        levelArr[v] = levelArr[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return levelArr[t] != 0;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int t, int f) {
            if (u == t) return f;
            int sent = 0;

            for (int i = iterArr[u]; i < adj[u].size(); ++i) {
                iterArr[u] = i;
                Edge e = adj[u].get(i);
                int v = e.to;
                if (e.cap == 0 || levelArr[v] != levelArr[u] + 1) continue;
                if (dist[v] != dist[u] + e.cost - potential[v] + potential[u]) continue;

                int ret = dfs(v, t, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                if (ret > 0) {
                    sent += ret;
                    f -= ret;
                    e.cap -= ret;
                    adj[v].get(e.rev).cap += ret;
                    if (f == 0) break;
                }
            }
            return sent;
        }

        int[] minCostFlow(int s, int t, int maxFlow) {
            int flow = 0, cost = 0;
            Arrays.fill(potential, 0);

            while (dijkstra(s, t)) {
                int phaseFlow = 0;

                while (buildLevelGraph(s, t)) {
                    Arrays.fill(iterArr, 0);
                    int df = dfs(s, t, maxFlow);
                    maxFlow -= df;
                    phaseFlow += df;
                    if (maxFlow == 0) break;
                }

                flow += phaseFlow;
                cost += (dist[t] + potential[t]) * phaseFlow;

                for (int i = 0; i < nodes; ++i) {
                    if (dist[i] != INF) potential[i] += dist[i];
                }

                if (maxFlow == 0) break;
            }

            return new int[]{flow, cost};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        MinCostFlow mcmf = new MinCostFlow();
        int L = Math.max(n, k) * 2;

        mcmf.addNodes(L * n);
        int s = mcmf.addNodes(1);
        int t = mcmf.addNodes(1);

        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
            int a = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            mcmf.addEdge(s, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int z = 0; z < m; ++z) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;

            for (int i = 0; i + 1 < L; ++i) {
                int u1 = u + i * n;
                int v1 = v + (i + 1) * n;
                int u2 = u + (i + 1) * n;
                int v2 = v + i * n;

                for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
                    int w = c + d * (2 * j + 1);
                    mcmf.addEdge(u1, v1, 1, w);
                    mcmf.addEdge(v2, u2, 1, w);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < L; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                int u = j + i * n;
                int v = j + (i + 1) * n;
                mcmf.addEdge(u, v, INF, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < L; ++i) {
            mcmf.addEdge(i * n, t, INF, 0);
        }

        int[] result = mcmf.minCostFlow(s, t, INF);
        System.out.println(result[1]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
